give me solutions rare, not problems - ok, fine, here's what i'd do if i'm Ronin r/n:

imo, price is down only without new users
so primary focus is UA, secondary focus is games 

1) ignore anything that isn't gaming

to be king of the gaming chains, it has to be this way

2) group games into casual, degen/casino/gamba, and everything else

this helps with targeting our new users 

3) facilitate sharing (links > creator codes)

provide all games with an out of the box referral system that uses links, not creator codes (Tribally has this)

4) show meaningful support to Ronin builders -tweeting 'look at the price of this NFT collection' does nothing, Ronin games need to be front & centre of ad campaigns 

example 1: video

- create promo content (3 genres to get you going - casual, degen/casino/gamba, everything else)
- leverage sth like Sploot from @jonahblake so you have a wealth of footage
- spend on ad placements where gamer traffic is high (YouTube, TikTok & in-game would be my starting point, then moving to streamers) 

side note:
i'd pause all spend on creators who have no reach outside of CT (300 creators producing 15000 pieces of content in 7 days just spams the TL and does nothing for UA)

example 2: written/blog/advertorial 

- leverage AI to turn threads from the likes of @0xnathan into long form articles and distribute on sites with high gamer traffic
- incentivise long form content (manual at first, then automated)

example 3: physical

- Ronin x Jolibee / McDonalds is easy, but not cheap
- put a mascot (the @SkyMavisHQ Bird? @Ronin_Network's Jin on a Ship? @RonkeOnRon?) into kids happy meals
- this could be part of a longer term play where kids become familiar with Ronin IP over time, but i'd be doing more here and making sure the toys have a QR code so that kids can claim a playable (and onchain) version of the toy they just got
- give those kids a frictionless way to play their new character in sth like Axie DoLL (Ronin Wallet lite?)

example 4: education

- partner with someone like @bitskwela, who focus on blockchain education in Filipino schools
- this is a longer term strategy but when we did this there were short term benefits, including a nice users spike and a front page feature on a national newspaper in the Philippines 

5) no more onchain games

- most of them are terrible and have token baggage
- onboard offchain indie studies to Ronin
- they will like the super cheap UA
- let them lean on web3 elements as needed
- (you know Tribally has this tech)
- onchain interactions are good for $RON (minting of e.g. achievements, daily streaks, player archetypes) 
- all players transact in $RON 

disclaimer:
- this is a mind dump with no prior planning

[5:53PM] #AjegunleApapa #TrafficUpdate 

Vehicular movement from Otto Wharf towards Ajeromi is proceeding at a rapid pace. Similarly, the route from Ojo Road through Okoya to Ajeromi is experiencing fast-moving traffic. At the Ajeromi intersection, all commercial buses are currently being diverted to Ojora Street as an alternative route to connect with the Boundary Bus Stop.

 The stretch from Baale to the Boundary Roundabout is also characterized by fast-moving traffic.
Furthermore, the Mobil Road axis, both towards Marine Beach and on the return journey to Ajegunle, is currently reporting good traffic flow. The Ijora Oloopa/High Bridge route, extending through Total and up to Danlami, is experiencing fast-moving traffic in both lanes.

 However, it is noted that while one lane from Danlami towards Area B is clear and moving well, the second lane is currently occupied by flatbed trucks. Lastly, the movement of vehicles exiting Apapa via the Marine Bridge is also proceeding at a fast pace. 

No traffic impediments have been reported during this period, and our officers remain on site to ensure the continued smooth flow of traffic.

#FollowLASTMA
